estimates_and_gaps: Selected Mk8Mod0/Mk13Mod4 combination is explicitly supported by OP1112, but is an original scenario selection rather than a proven photograph serial-number identity.
Ground anchorage depth, foundation internal construction and exact rear-side small parts remain unmeasured.
Base fore-aft width53in and trunnion height40.3in read from original plate; approximate dimensions retain approximate status.
6.477m is the51-caliber bore reference, not muzzle-to-trunnion distance.
Exact entry-into-service year, CommonMod14 filler/fuze and crew-operated firing cycle need further primary evidence or explicit provisional handling.
No AI target, Godot model, installation or engine/browser validation exists in this research phase.

variant_comparison.allowed_use: Variant boundary only; Mod6 also permits Mk15 Mod0 gun, unlike chosen Mod4 table. Do not silently merge compatibility lists.
